svg.title: RailLab — Alpine descent
svg.desc: Static Bezier track analysis. Educational held-to-rail point mass. All values in SI units. Unconfirmed points excluded.

g.text: Complete · 8 points · Track 181.87 m · Traversed 181.87 m · Max speed 27.83 m/s · Peak felt load 5.12 g
v0 4 m/s · Mass 300 kg · g 9.80665 m/s² · Resistance 0.025 m/s² · CdA 0.35 m² · Air 1.225 kg/m³ · Step 0.15 m
The cart reaches the end of the track. All graphs describe one forward pass.

Model: open 2D track; point mass constrained to the rails; gravity, quadratic air drag and constant resistance. Normal load is signed relative to the left normal. Felt load is the resultant non-gravitational force / (m g). Time and peak values are numerical
estimates. No free flight, backwards pass, train geometry, banking or structural model. Educational analysis, not engineering certification.
